name: exper-monorepo
description: Exper – Personal Expense Tracker and Financial Planning Dashboard

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install

author: Exper Team
